The '''North Slope''' was the northern region of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was home to several industrial cities. Prior to the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s invasion of Alanciar in [[2975 BBY]], the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[wardmaster]] [[Quarra Thayn]] was officially "touring" the Northern Slope's industrial cities. In reality, she had traveled to the south-western frontier fort of [[Point Defiance]] to meet her lover [[Jogan Halder]], a [[signal officer]] in the Alanciari [[Signal Corps]].
